records.source: Greetings! I'm Demetrius, local scientist and father. Thanks for introducing yourself!#$e#I'm studying the local plants and animals from my home laboratory.#$b#Have you met my daughter Maru? She's interested to meet you.
records.translation: 你好！我是德米特里厄斯，當地科學家，也是一位父親。謝謝你自我介紹！#$e#我在家中的實驗室研究當地動植物。#$b#你見過我女兒瑪魯嗎？她很想認識你。

records.source: Wow, this is a rare substance. I'll have to take it to the lab for... uh... further analysis.
records.translation: 哇，這是稀有物質。我得帶到實驗室進行……呃……進一步分析。

records.source: A present!... with optimal timing. Today is the anniversary of my birth. Thank you!$h
records.translation: 禮物！……時機恰到好處。今天是我出生的週年紀念日。謝謝！$h

records.source: A present!... with optimal timing. Today is the anniversary of my birth.$h#$b#Let's see what it is... $h#$b#...Oh.$s
records.translation: 禮物！……時機恰到好處。今天是我出生的週年紀念日。$h#$b#來看看是什麼……$h#$b#……喔。$s

records.source: Wow, an intact dinosaur egg! This is an extremely rare specimen. Now, if only it could be incubated...
records.translation: 哇，一顆完整的恐龍蛋！這是極其稀有的標本。現在，要是能孵化就好了……

records.source: I already spotted a rare crab. This place is great.$h
records.translation: 我已經發現一隻稀有螃蟹。這地方太棒了。$h

records.source: Don't mind me, @. I'm just collecting some samples. This may be a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity!$7#$e#Erm... If you see my wife, can you tell her I'm okay?$7
records.translation: 別管我，@。我只是在收集一些樣本。這也許是一生僅有一次的機會！$7#$e#呃……如果見到我妻子，可以告訴她我沒事嗎？$7

records.source: The rain appears to be harmless, so I'm taking less precaution this year.
records.translation: 這場雨似乎無害，所以今年我採取的防護措施少了一些。

records.source: I heard you visited Calico Desert recently. How fascinating! I'm sure you observed many unique life forms on your trip.
records.translation: 聽說你最近去了卡利科沙漠。太迷人了！我相信你在旅途中觀察到許多獨特生命形式。

records.source: Checking up on the melon research? Yes, I... uh... 'analyzed' it, and it certainly has an optimal macronutrient profile...
records.translation: 來關心甜瓜研究嗎？對，我……呃……「分析」過了，它的巨量營養素組成確實非常理想……

records.source: Say that again!? You successfully incubated a dinosaur egg? This is unprecedented!$5#$e#Here, take my coffee, I'm all worked up now... I can't drink any more. [253]
records.translation: 再說一次！？你成功孵化了恐龍蛋？這是前所未有的！$5#$e#來，拿走我的咖啡，我現在太激動了……不能再喝。[253]

records.source: Yes, Maru told me the news. I can't say I'm thrilled about it, but maybe you'll prove me wrong.$u
records.translation: 對，瑪魯告訴我了。不能說我對此很高興，但也許你會證明我的擔心是錯的。$u

records.source: *sigh*... @, I've come to accept that it's time for my 'little girl' to become a woman. You have my blessing.$s
records.translation: *嘆氣*……@，我已經接受自己的「小女孩」該成為大人了。我祝福你們。$s

records.source: Congratulations on the marriage. Robin's been crying since the wedding. 'Tears of joy', as she calls it! A most peculiar concept...#$e#Hmm, now that the basement is unoccupied, I might have to expand the laboratory...$u
records.translation: 恭喜結婚。羅賓從婚禮後一直在哭。她稱那是「喜悅的眼淚」！真是奇特的概念……#$e#嗯，既然地下室空出來了，我也許該擴建實驗室……$u

records.source: $y 'How's that cave experiment coming along? Has it produced anything of value yet?_Yes_Ah! That means the conditions must be more suitable than I originally theorized... hmm..._No_Well, keep checking on it every now and then. I'm sure those little guys will yield something eventually.'
records.translation: $y '那項洞穴實驗進行得怎麼樣？已經產出有價值的東西了嗎？_有_啊！這表示條件一定比我原先推測的更合適……嗯……_沒有_嗯，記得偶爾去查看。我相信那些小傢伙最終會產出東西。'

records.source: Don't forget to check that farm cave! There's bound to be something useful in there by now.
records.translation: 別忘了查看農場洞穴！現在裡面一定有些有用的東西。

records.source: I'll be analyzing this data for months.
records.translation: 這些資料夠我分析好幾個月。

records.source: *crunch*... whoops, there goes an endangered crab species...$s#$b#...#$b#Oh, never mind. It was just the empty shell! I can sleep tonight.
records.translation: *喀嚓*……糟糕，一種瀕危螃蟹就這樣沒了……$s#$b#……#$b#喔，沒事。只是空殼！我今晚睡得著了。

records.source: Are you having fun, @? You need to remember to take breaks now and then too!
records.translation: 玩得開心嗎，@？你也要記得偶爾休息！

records.source: I usually don't partake... but I'm usually not on a tropical island, either. Hahaha.$h
records.translation: 我通常不喝酒……但我通常也不在熱帶島嶼上。哈哈哈。$h

records.source: Can you believe this place? It's teeming with exotic life!
records.translation: 你能相信這地方嗎？到處都是奇異生命！

records.source: It's a good specimen, but a very common species. You can keep it.
records.translation: 這是份好標本，但物種非常常見。你留著吧。

records.source: Fruit and salt? What an odd combination...$s
records.translation: 水果和鹽？真是奇怪的組合……$s

records.source: Robin won't even tell *me* who paid for Pam's new house!#$e#I pretend I'm mad at her but secretly I'm glad she's so loyal to her word...$h
records.translation: 羅賓連誰替潘姆的新房子付錢都不肯告訴*我*！#$e#我假裝生她的氣，但心裡其實很高興她這麼信守承諾……$h

records.source: Maru helps me out in the lab sometimes... She's a good kid.
records.translation: 瑪魯有時會在實驗室幫忙……她是個好孩子。

records.source: It's hard to do good science without Maru's help...#$b#But her happiness is much more important than my experiment!
records.translation: 沒有瑪魯幫忙，很難做好科學研究……#$b#但她的幸福遠比我的實驗重要！

records.source: This valley has a very vibrant and diverse ecosystem. That's one reason I was excited to move here.
records.translation: 這座山谷擁有充滿活力又多樣的生態系統。這正是我很期待搬來的原因之一。

records.source: You're probably growing a lot of interesting plants on your farm, huh?#$e#Maybe I'll stop by your place some day and check it out.
records.translation: 你的農場大概種了很多有趣植物，對吧？#$e#也許哪天我會去拜訪，親自看看。

records.source: How's the farming business going? It's parsnip season, isn't it?#$e#I can imagine it being pretty peaceful, working outdoors with plants all day.
records.translation: 農場生意怎麼樣？現在是歐防風季節，對吧？#$e#我能想像整天在戶外和植物一起工作，應該相當平靜。

records.source: Robin has a hot temper. It's better to stay on her good side.#$e#Don't tell her I said that.$h
records.translation: 羅賓脾氣很火爆。最好別惹她生氣。#$e#別告訴她是我說的。$h

records.source: Let's see... If compounds in the rhizosphere contain sufficient levels of Carbon-13, then...$u#$b#Oh! Sorry. I was pondering some data and I didn't notice you there.#$e#Do you need anything?
records.translation: 讓我想想……如果根際中的化合物含有足量碳-13，那麼……$u#$b#喔！抱歉。我正在思考一些資料，沒注意到你。#$e#你需要什麼嗎？

records.source: It's good to take a break from work every now and then.#$e#I guess that's kind of difficult when you live on a farm, though.#$e#Hey, at least in the winter you don't have to worry about crops.
records.translation: 偶爾暫停工作休息一下很好。#$e#不過住在農場大概很難做到。#$e#嘿，至少冬季不用擔心作物。

records.source: Robin has a hot temper. It's better to stay on her good side.#$e#...now if I could only quantify her mood levels, perhaps I could model the fluctuations using a sinusoidal curve...$u
records.translation: 羅賓脾氣很火爆。最好別惹她生氣。#$e#……要是能量化她的情緒程度，也許我能用正弦曲線建立波動模型……$u

records.source: Hi @! How are you doing today?#$e#I wish I could make your farming job easier somehow.
records.translation: 嗨，@！今天過得怎麼樣？#$e#真希望我能用某種方式讓你的農務更輕鬆。

records.source: Really? I figured a farmer would know the correct answer...$s
records.translation: 真的嗎？我以為農夫會知道正確答案……$s

records.source: See? @ agrees with me.
records.translation: 看吧？@同意我的說法。

records.source: Well, we'd better titrate this solution before it crystallizes on us.
records.translation: 嗯，最好趁這份溶液還沒結晶前進行滴定。

records.source: *sigh*... %fork$4
records.translation: *嘆氣*……%fork$4

records.source: #$e#%Demetrius is deep in thought.#$e#Sorry, I'm really busy.#$e#There's so many plants to study right now.
records.translation: #$e#%Demetrius正陷入沉思。#$e#抱歉，我真的很忙。#$e#現在有太多植物需要研究。

records.source: Make sure to water your plants every day.#$e#Although, if you're using water retaining soil you don't need to worry about watering as often.#$e#It's pretty convenient.
records.translation: 務必每天替植物澆水。#$e#不過，如果使用保水土壤，就不用那麼常澆水。#$e#相當方便。

records.source: How's the farming business going? It's tomato season, isn't it?#$e#I can imagine it being pretty peaceful, working outdoors with plants all day.
records.translation: 農場生意怎麼樣？現在是番茄季節，對吧？#$e#我能想像整天在戶外和植物一起工作，應該相當平靜。

records.source: $p 40#So I heard Maru had you look through that telescope out back.|If you and Maru become friends, I'm sure she'll show you how to use that telescope out back.#$e#Pretty exciting, huh?
records.translation: $p 40#我聽說瑪魯讓你用後面那座望遠鏡觀察。|如果你和瑪魯成為朋友，我相信她會教你使用後面那座望遠鏡。#$e#很令人興奮，對吧？

records.source: I hope my daughter's keeping up on her math and science!
records.translation: 希望我女兒仍有持續鑽研數學和科學！

records.source: Hmm... If strigolactone levels could be increased, would it have a proportional effect on mycorrhizal growth?$u#$b#Oh! Sorry. I was pondering some data and I didn't notice you there.#$e#Do you need anything?
records.translation: 嗯……如果能提高獨腳金內酯含量，菌根生長是否會成比例增加？$u#$b#喔！抱歉。我正在思考一些資料，沒注意到你。#$e#你需要什麼嗎？

records.source: I became a scientist because I wanted to contribute to the progression of our species.#$e#Of course, none of this would be possible without farmers such as yourself.$h
records.translation: 我成為科學家，是因為想為我們物種的進步做出貢獻。#$e#當然，沒有像你這樣的農夫，這一切都不可能實現。$h

records.source: During this time of year I divert my attentions to fungi.
records.translation: 每年這段時間，我會把注意力轉向真菌。

records.source: We know a lot about nature thanks to science.#$e#But there's always a lot more to learn.
records.translation: 多虧科學，我們對大自然了解很多。#$e#但永遠還有更多知識需要學習。

records.source: How's the farming business going? It's corn season, isn't it?#$e#I can imagine it being pretty peaceful, working outdoors with plants all day.
records.translation: 農場生意怎麼樣？現在是玉米季節，對吧？#$e#我能想像整天在戶外和植物一起工作，應該相當平靜。

records.source: Maru sure spends a lot of time working on those gadgets of hers.#$e#I'm glad she's so dedicated.
records.translation: 瑪魯確實花了很多時間製作那些裝置。#$e#我很高興她如此投入。

records.source: I'm still flabbergasted about Maru's secret robot... was it all a dream?
records.translation: 瑪魯的祕密機器人仍讓我目瞪口呆……那一切是夢嗎？

records.source: Let's see... perhaps the nitrogen fixation level is affected by nematode secretions...$u#$b#Oh! Sorry. I was pondering some data and I didn't notice you there.#$e#Do you need anything?
records.translation: 讓我想想……固氮程度也許會受到線蟲分泌物影響……$u#$b#喔！抱歉。我正在思考一些資料，沒注意到你。#$e#你需要什麼嗎？

records.source: Hi @. I'm always glad when you come for a visit.#$e#It's nice to have some company after all this lonely lab-work.
records.translation: 嗨，@。你來拜訪總讓我很高興。#$e#做了這麼多孤獨的實驗室工作後，有人陪伴真好。

records.source: I'm taking a break from my research right now.
records.translation: 我現在正暫時放下研究休息。

records.source: Talk to my wife if you want to increase the size of your house.
records.translation: 想擴建房屋的話，就去找我妻子。

records.source: Do you have a kitchen in your house yet?#$e#Cooking is kind of like doing lab work.
records.translation: 你家裡已經有廚房了嗎？#$e#烹飪有點像實驗室工作。

records.source: Do you have any animals on your farm?
records.translation: 你的農場有養動物嗎？

records.source: Hello.#$e#%Demetrius seems lost in thought.
records.translation: 你好。#$e#%Demetrius似乎陷入沉思。

records.source: Let's see... if seasonal nitrogen levels could be modeled by a piecewise function...$u#$b#Oh! Sorry. I was analyzing data and I didn't notice you there.#$e#Do you need anything?
records.translation: 讓我想想……如果能用分段函數為季節性氮含量建立模型……$u#$b#喔！抱歉。我正在分析資料，沒注意到你。#$e#你需要什麼嗎？

records.source: Feel free to harvest as much lumber and stone from this area as you please.
records.translation: 你可以隨意從這一帶採集任意數量的木材和石頭。

records.source: Thanks for stopping by. I need to think about something other than legumes for a while.#$e#So, what have you been doing lately?#$e#That sounds interesting.
records.translation: 謝謝你過來。我需要暫時想點豆科植物以外的事情。#$e#所以，你最近在做什麼？#$e#聽起來很有趣。
